label: Basic wages and wage payment
description: General wage entitlement and payment rules excluding changing regional rate amounts.
example_questions_or_material: My employer has not paid my salary on time.

label: Exact regional minimum-wage amounts
description: Current peso rates depend on region, sector, category, tranche, and current wage orders.
example_questions_or_material: What is today's minimum wage in Region IV-A?
default_referral: NWPC or applicable Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board
notes: General wage-setting framework may still be answered.

label: Hours of work
description: Basic rules on compensable working time and ordinary hours.
example_questions_or_material: Is my required waiting time considered working time?

label: Rest days
description: Basic weekly rest-day rights and related rules.
example_questions_or_material: Can my employer require me to work on my rest day?

label: Overtime pay
description: Basic overtime entitlement and premium rules.
example_questions_or_material: Do I receive additional pay after working more than eight hours?

label: Holiday and premium pay
description: Basic holiday, special-day, and premium-pay rules within the available current sources.
example_questions_or_material: How is work on a regular holiday paid?
notes: Time-specific holiday advisories require freshness checks.

label: Thirteenth-month pay
description: Coverage, timing, and basic computation principles supported by verified authorities.
example_questions_or_material: Am I entitled to thirteenth-month pay?

label: Basic employment-contract concerns
description: Basic private-sector contract and employment-status concerns within the verified sources.
example_questions_or_material: My contract calls me project-based; what does that generally mean?
notes: Do not predict an individual case outcome.

label: Termination and procedural due process
description: Basic just or authorized causes and procedural notice requirements.
example_questions_or_material: Can I be dismissed without written notice?
default_referral: DOLE, SEnA, or NLRC as appropriate

label: Final pay and certificate of employment
description: Basic final-pay and certificate-of-employment guidance.
example_questions_or_material: When should my final pay and COE be released?

label: Labor complaints and referrals
description: Basic SEnA and agency-routing information.
example_questions_or_material: Where can I ask for help about unpaid wages?
default_referral: DOLE SEnA, NCMB, or NLRC as appropriate
notes: Procedure depends on issue and jurisdiction.

label: Overseas Filipino workers
description: Overseas employment is governed by specialized institutions and rules.
example_questions_or_material: My overseas recruiter violated my contract.

label: Seafarers
description: Seafarer employment and disability disputes require specialized sources.
example_questions_or_material: How much seafarer disability compensation can I claim?
default_referral: Department of Migrant Workers or qualified counsel

label: Government employees
description: Government employment is generally governed by civil-service rules.
example_questions_or_material: Can a government employee file this claim with DOLE?

label: Kasambahays
description: Domestic workers are covered by specialized legislation not included in the initial module.
example_questions_or_material: What benefits must my household employer provide?
default_referral: DOLE or local government desk handling kasambahay concerns

label: Union elections and complex collective bargaining
description: Complex union representation and collective-bargaining matters are outside the MVP.
example_questions_or_material: How do we challenge a union election result?

label: Workers' compensation and disability
description: Benefits and disability computations require specialized sources and factual review.
example_questions_or_material: How much disability compensation will I receive?
default_referral: Employees' Compensation Commission or SSS/GSIS as appropriate

label: Occupational-safety compliance
description: Detailed occupational-safety compliance is outside the initial scope.
example_questions_or_material: Does our factory comply with OSH standards?
default_referral: DOLE Occupational Safety and Health Center or DOLE regional office

label: Retirement and pension computations
description: Retirement and social-insurance computations require additional laws and current data.
example_questions_or_material: Calculate my SSS pension.

label: Pending labor cases
description: The system does not assess or intervene in pending proceedings.
example_questions_or_material: What should I argue in my pending NLRC case?
default_referral: Qualified Philippine lawyer or PAO if eligible
notes: General process information may still be provided if separately supported.

label: Personalized case-outcome prediction
description: The system must not predict whether a user will win or lose.
example_questions_or_material: Will I win my illegal-dismissal case?

label: General consumer-law framework
description: Short title, policy, construction, coverage, and other general provisions that provide context but may not independently establish a remedy.
example_questions_or_material: What law is called the Consumer Act of the Philippines?
notes: Context provisions should not be over-tagged as support for every substantive consumer topic.

label: Defective products
description: Basic rights and remedies involving defective consumer products.
example_questions_or_material: The appliance I bought stopped working immediately.

label: Product warranties
description: Basic express and implied warranty concerns supported by verified sources.
example_questions_or_material: The seller refuses to honor the warranty.

label: Repair, replacement, and refund
description: Available consumer remedies within the verified scope.
example_questions_or_material: Can I request a replacement instead of another repair?
notes: Remedy depends on facts and governing provision.

label: Deceptive or unfair sales practices
description: Basic deceptive, unfair, or unconscionable sales practices.
example_questions_or_material: The seller hid an important condition until after payment.

label: Misleading advertisements
description: Basic false or misleading advertising concerns.
example_questions_or_material: The product does not match the advertisement.
default_referral: DTI or the agency with product jurisdiction

label: Price tags and displayed prices
description: Displayed-price and exact-change concerns.
example_questions_or_material: The cashier charged more than the shelf price.

label: Product safety
description: General consumer-product safety concerns within DTI jurisdiction.
example_questions_or_material: A household product appears unsafe.
default_referral: DTI or the appropriate product regulator
notes: Food, drugs, and specialized products may require another agency.

label: Basic service complaints
description: General consumer-service complaints within DTI jurisdiction.
example_questions_or_material: I paid for a repair service that was not completed.
notes: Specialized regulated services may be excluded.

label: Ordinary online consumer transactions
description: Covered business-to-consumer internet transactions under the Internet Transactions Act and Consumer Act.
example_questions_or_material: An online shop will not deliver or refund my purchase.
default_referral: DTI E-Commerce Bureau or DTI Consumer CARe
notes: Criminal fraud, privacy, finance, and C2C boundaries require separate routing.

label: DTI complaint procedure and referrals
description: Basic mediation, adjudication, and no-wrong-door referral information.
example_questions_or_material: How do I file a consumer complaint with DTI?

label: Banking, lending, and credit-card disputes
description: Financial consumer disputes require specialized banking and credit authorities.
example_questions_or_material: My bank charged an unauthorized credit-card fee.
default_referral: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas or the applicable regulator
notes: Consumer Act provisions must be filtered at provision level.

label: Insurance
description: Insurance disputes require specialized law and regulation.
example_questions_or_material: My insurer denied my claim.

label: Investments and securities
description: Investment and securities disputes are outside the consumer MVP.
example_questions_or_material: An investment platform will not release my money.

label: Telecommunications
description: Telecommunications service disputes require current sector-specific regulation.
example_questions_or_material: My mobile provider charged me incorrectly.

label: Data privacy
description: Privacy complaints require the Data Privacy Act and NPC materials.
example_questions_or_material: An online seller exposed my personal information.
notes: A supported transaction portion may still be answered separately.

label: Medical malpractice
description: Medical negligence requires specialized legal and factual assessment.
example_questions_or_material: Can I sue a doctor for malpractice?
default_referral: Qualified Philippine lawyer or appropriate professional regulator

label: Real-estate transactions
description: Real-estate sales and housing regulation require specialized sources.
example_questions_or_material: A developer delayed turnover of my condominium.
default_referral: Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development or DHSUD adjudication bodies

label: Transportation regulation
description: Passenger and transport disputes may fall under specialized regulators.
example_questions_or_material: An airline refused compensation for my flight issue.
default_referral: Civil Aeronautics Board or appropriate transport regulator

label: Utility billing
description: Electricity and water billing are governed by specialized regulators.
example_questions_or_material: My electricity bill suddenly doubled.
default_referral: Energy Regulatory Commission or the applicable water regulator

label: Online fraud requiring criminal investigation
description: Potential criminal scams require law-enforcement and specialized investigation.
example_questions_or_material: I sent money to an online seller who disappeared.
default_referral: Philippine National Police Anti-Cybercrime Group, NBI Cybercrime Division, or appropriate authority
notes: The noncriminal consumer-transaction portion may be handled separately.
